text:
The plate looks like a square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across, which is about 460 px in the photo. That works out to about 0.057 cm per px.

The scrambled eggs cover roughly 220 px by 250 px, or about 12 by 14 cm. Counting only the filled area, that is around 90 cm². At about 1.5 cm thick, the volume is roughly 130 cm³. Scrambled eggs are loose and airy, so I assume a density of about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives roughly 80-100 g. Scrambled eggs run about 150-200 kcal per 100 g, and with added oil that comes to about 160 kcal for 90 g.

The bacon is a single strip, about 20 cm long when curled, and it weighs around 8 g. At roughly 45 kcal per strip, that adds about 45 kcal.

Total: about 205 kcal and about 100 g of food.
